senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; denom. of זקק) [junction, touch; cmp. נגע, רע &c.,] accident, evil, injury, damage; תַּשְׁלוּמֵי נ׳ indemnity.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:7">Ab. Zar. I, 7</cite> <he>וכל דבר שיש בו נ׳ לרבים</he> or anything through which the public may be injured.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:1">B. Kam. I, 1</cite> <he>חב … לשלם תשלומי נ׳ וכ׳</he> the offender is bound to pay indemnity with the best of the land (out of his best lands, v. <cite ref="P00512"><he>עִידִית</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>הכשרתי במקצת נִזְקוֹ</he> I have been partly instrumental in injuring him, v. <cite ref="E00526"><he>הֶכְשֵׁר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:5">Ib. II, 5</cite>, a. fr. <he>חצי נ׳</he> indemnity up to half the damage, opp. <he>נ׳ שלם</he> full indemnity.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">Ib. VIII, 1</cite> <he>בנ׳ בצער וכ׳</he> (has to pay) damages (for the maimed limb), an indemnity for the pain inflicted &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְזָקִים</he>, <cite ref="N00463"><he>נְזָקִין</he></cite>; constr. <he>נִזְקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 84a:17">Ib. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>דנין נ׳ מנ׳ וכ׳</he> we may draw an analogy between different cases of mayhem, but not between mayhem and homicide.
Ib. נ׳ שור בשור damages for an ox injured by an ox; a. fr.—נְזָקִין, נְזִיקִין (fr. נָזִיק) cases of damages, laws concerning injuries; damages.
Ib. I, 1, v. אָב II. Mekh. Mishp. s. 14; a. fr., v. נִיזָּקִין.—Esp. N’ziḳin, (Seder N’ziḳin) name of the fourth Order of the Mishnah, Tosefta and Talmud, also of a section of M’khilta Mishpaṭim.
Lev. R. s. 19 נ׳ ל׳ פרקים N. which contains thirty chapters; a. e.—
B. Kam. 102ᵃ כולה נ׳ חדא וכ׳ the entire N’ziḳin (Baba Ḳamma, M’tsiʿa and Bathra) is one treatise.
